title: Ring counter (HyperFrames block)
description: A gold ring closes around a number that counts up to yours (GSAP DrawSVG + snap), then the unit, a rule and one line slide in. A HyperFrames-format block played as it is.

source.note: our own block in the HyperFrames format; blocks from heygen-com/hyperframes (Apache-2.0) run the same way
